result.final_text:
## What this letter says
You had pain in your right knee. You had a knee replacement (total knee arthroplasty) many years ago. The pain and soreness slowly got worse.
An X-ray showed the plastic part (poly) looks very worn.
You had an operation on your right knee. This is called a poly exchange. The plastic parts of the knee were replaced.
You recovered well. You could walk with a little help during physical therapy. The nerve block was taken out. You did well on pain pills by mouth.
Your condition is stable on discharge. Your INR was 1.9. INR is a blood test. It shows how long your blood takes to clot.

## What you need to do
1. Go home. Your son will care for you.
2. Eat your regular diet.
3. Put weight on your right leg as much as you can manage.
4. Keep doing your physical therapy exercises.
5. Have lab (INR) checks twice a week.
6. Take your medicines as listed below.
7. See Dr. ABC in two weeks.

## Dates and medicines
- Follow up with Dr. ABC in two weeks. No exact date is given.
- Coumadin: 4 milligrams a day. This is new. You go home on it because your INR was 1.9. The letter does not say how long you will take it. It does not say how the dose may change after your INR checks.
- Vicodin: 5/500 milligrams. This is new. Take 1 to 2 tablets by mouth every 4 to 6 hours. The letter does not give a daily maximum.
- Home medicines: keep taking your usual ones. The letter does not list which ones.
- The letter does not give the date of your surgery or discharge.

## Questions to ask your doctor
- How long will I take Coumadin? Could my dose change after my INR checks?
- What is the most Vicodin I can take in one day?
- Which of my home medicines should I take again?
- What is a poly exchange, and what does Coumadin do?

## When to get urgent help
Call the office or go back to the emergency room if you have:
- more redness
- swelling
- drainage
- fever
- any worry about your operation or the cut (incision) site

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
